about.usage: a preposition that introduces a topic.

and.meaning: a word that connects related things
and.example: i brought a book and a pencil.

belift.meaning: part of the credited name belift lab
belift.usage: a name in the poster's music video credit.
belift.example: the credit includes the name belift lab.

butterflies.meaning: a fluttery feeling of nervous excitement
butterflies.usage: a figurative feeling, often linked to a crush.
butterflies.example: i felt butterflies before our first meeting.

cherish.meaning: to care for deeply and hold dear
cherish.usage: a verb used with a person, memory, or feeling.

come.meaning: to arrive, move toward, or take a position
come.usage: in come second, it introduces a rank or priority.
come.example: kindness and rest come first in our home.

comes.meaning: arrives or takes a particular position
comes.usage: the present form of come with he, she, or it.

curious.meaning: wanting to know or learn more
curious.usage: curious about introduces what interests you.
curious.example: i am curious about your favorite novel.

end.usage: to the end means until something finishes.
end.example: we stayed until the end of the film.

excitement.meaning: a strong feeling of eager happiness
excitement.usage: a noun naming the feeling of being excited.

fan.meaning: someone who admires an artist or work
fan.usage: here it describes the perspective behind the poster.
fan.example: a fan made this little scrapbook.

feelings.usage: plural of feeling; here, someone's inner emotions.
feelings.example: a journal helps me understand my feelings.

first.meaning: before all others; highest in priority
first.usage: can describe order or what matters most.

first-love.meaning: connected with a person's earliest romantic love
first-love.usage: the hyphen joins words that describe butterflies here.
first-love.example: the novel captures those first-love nerves.

growing.meaning: becoming bigger, older, or more developed
growing.usage: in growing pains, it describes discomfort during change.

grows.meaning: becomes bigger, stronger, or more developed
grows.usage: the present form of grow with he, she, or it.
grows.example: my interest in poetry grows each year.

heart.meaning: the inner place of emotions and affection
heart.usage: figurative here, rather than the physical organ.
heart.example: that small kindness warmed my heart.

illit.meaning: the artist name credited on this poster
illit.usage: a proper name, kept lowercase in this website's style.
illit.example: this page features a poster about illit.

inside.meaning: within something; in its inner part
inside.usage: a preposition that introduces an inner space.
inside.example: i left a note inside the book.

interpretation.meaning: a personal way of understanding or presenting something
interpretation.usage: here, the poster maker's reading of the song and video.
interpretation.example: your interpretation helped me notice the colors.

lab.meaning: part of the credited name belift lab
lab.usage: usually short for laboratory; here it belongs to a name.
lab.example: the final line credits belift lab.

love.usage: a noun here; it can also be a verb.
love.example: her letters are full of love.

mv.usage: an abbreviation used in the poster's source credit.
mv.example: the mv uses soft pink lighting.

my.usage: comes before a noun to show the speaker's connection.
my.example: my notebook is beside the window.

of.meaning: a word that links a thing to its source, part, or subject
of.usage: in seconds of worrying, it links a duration to an activity.
of.example: i saved a photograph of the garden.

only.usage: emphasizes that an amount is small or limited.

pains.usage: growing pains can describe the struggles of personal change.
pains.example: the story explores the growing pains of friendship.

protect.meaning: to keep someone or something safe from harm
protect.usage: a verb followed by the person or thing being kept safe.
protect.example: i protect my quiet time each morning.

repetition.meaning: the act of doing or saying something again
repetition.usage: a noun; repeated words can make an idea feel stronger.
repetition.example: gentle repetition helped me remember the phrase.

resolve.usage: a noun here, describing a steady decision or commitment.

right.usage: in right to the end, it adds emphasis to the full distance.
right.example: the path runs right to the shore.

second.meaning: after first in order; also a small unit of time
second.usage: come second marks priority; one second measures time.

seconds.meaning: units of time, each one sixtieth of a minute
seconds.usage: the plural of second when measuring time.
seconds.example: the screen lit up after five seconds.

shining.meaning: giving out light; seeming bright with happiness
shining.example: the street was shining after the rain.

teeth.meaning: the hard parts in the mouth used for biting
teeth.example: the child drew a smile with tiny teeth.

the.meaning: a word that points to a particular thing
the.usage: a definite article placed before a noun.
the.example: the record is on the shelf.

three.usage: a number used before a plural countable noun.
three.example: three birds landed near the window.

to.meaning: toward or as far as a place or point
to.usage: in to the end, it marks the final point reached.
to.example: we walked to the old bridge.

tooth.meaning: one of the hard parts in the mouth used for biting
tooth.usage: singular of teeth; wisdom tooth names a back tooth.
tooth.example: a tiny tooth appeared in her drawing.

us.meaning: me and one or more other people
us.usage: the object form of we, used after verbs or prepositions.
us.example: the photograph reminds us of summer.

wisdom.meaning: good judgment gained through knowledge or experience
wisdom.usage: with tooth or teeth, it forms the name of a back tooth.
wisdom.example: her stories offered a little everyday wisdom.

worrying.meaning: thinking anxiously about a problem or possibility
worrying.usage: the -ing form of worry, naming an activity here.
worrying.example: i stopped worrying when your message arrived.

your.meaning: belonging or relating to the person being addressed
your.usage: comes before a noun to show its connection to you.
your.example: your playlist kept me company on the train.
